page_title: MAR 0-3 PSG | Marseille v PSG 27/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' The ball is cleared after Senny Mayulu (PSG) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90+1' The linesman signals that Ousmane Dembele (PSG) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
90' We will have 2 min. of added time.
90' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) is caught offside!
88' The goalkeeper pulls off a remarkable reflex save to deny a rebound from Marco Asensio (PSG)! That was a huge opportunity!

87' A cross to the edge of the box finds Marco Asensio (PSG) who takes a nice first touch and tries to beat the keeper with quick shot towards the bottom left corner. Geronimo Rulli pulls off a good save and the score remains the same.
85' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to make a change. Pol Lirola (Marseille) replaces Luis Henrique.

85' What a chance that is! Lilian Brassier (Marseille) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, but he steers his header narrowly over the crossbar.
85' It seemed like Ismael Kone (Marseille) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
85' Lucas Beraldo (PSG) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Francois Letexier blows his whistle for a foul.
83' Fine play by Desire Doue (PSG) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles over the bar.
83' A pass into the penalty area from Desire Doue (PSG) is intercepted by the defence.
82' Ismael Kone (Marseille) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
80' Achraf Hakimi sprays a pass out to Fabian Ruiz (PSG), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes high over the bar.
78' Desire Doue (PSG) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
78' The game has come to an end for Kang-In Lee (PSG). He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Senny Mayulu.
78' A substitution has been made. Joao Neves (PSG) goes off and Marco Asensio comes on.
75' Desire Doue (PSG) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman makes the right call and PSG will have a corner.
74' That's unlucky! Desire Doue (PSG) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.

72' Desire Doue (PSG) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Geronimo Rulli pulls off an easy save.
72' Ismael Kone (Marseille) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
70' Marquinhos (PSG) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post.
67' Desire Doue joins the action as a substitute, replacing Bradley Barcola (PSG).
67' The referee signals a substitution. Fabian Ruiz is brought on as a substitute for Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG).
64' Good defending. Bradley Barcola (PSG) tries to find Ousmane Dembele inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
64' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 24:76.
63' Vitinha (PSG) attempts to feed Kang-In Lee with a chip pass, but Geronimo Rulli reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
61' Luis Henrique (Marseille) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
59' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Joao Neves (PSG) heads on.
56' Bradley Barcola plays a short pass through to Ousmane Dembele (PSG) inside the box, but he balloons his effort high over the bar.
53' Wow, what an escape. Bradley Barcola (PSG) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
52' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
52' The game is interrupted as Lucas Beraldo (PSG) is flagged offside.
50' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nuno Mendes leaves the pitch and Lucas Beraldo (PSG) comes on.

50' Kang-In Lee (PSG) produces a brilliant low pass into the box, where Achraf Hakimi is already waiting. He attempts to dribble past the defence, but one of the defenders does well to dispossess him.
47' Achraf Hakimi sends a lofted pass into the box, Bradley Barcola (PSG) shows good awareness to connect with it but drags his shot well wide of the right post.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Elye Wahi (Marseille) is replaced by Ismael Kone.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Mason Greenwood (Marseille) comes off for Jonathan Rowe.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Luis Henrique (Marseille) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
45+3' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
43' Wonderful pass from Marquinhos (PSG) for Ousmane Dembele, but they can't profit from it as Geronimo Rulli comes off his line to collect.
40' 0 - 3 Goal - 0:3! Ousmane Dembele laid the ball off to Bradley Barcola (PSG), who slots it into the back of the net from close range, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.

40' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
37' Joao Neves (PSG) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
34' Kang-In Lee (PSG) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
33' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) works the corner short.
33' A lofted cross from Nuno Mendes (PSG) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out of play and PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
29' 0 - 2 Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) was unlucky to score an own goal attempting to intercept a cross. Hang your head in shame!
25' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick inside the box and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save.
24' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
24' Michael Murillo (Marseille) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
24' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
23' Marquinhos (PSG) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
21' Marquinhos (PSG) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
20' Amine Harit (Marseille) makes a tackle on his opponent and is shown a harsh red card by the referee!
20' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
19' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
18' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) was quite harsh and Francois Letexier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
15' Flag up against Luis Henrique (Marseille). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
14' Flag goes up against Bradley Barcola (PSG) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
13' Elye Wahi (Marseille) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Gianluigi Donnarumma gets down to his right to keep it out.
11' Half-chance! Bradley Barcola (PSG) plays a pass into the box, but Geronimo Rulli reacts well to snuff out the attack.
8' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) brings an opponent down and Francois Letexier interrupts the game.
7' 0 - 1 Goal! Joao Neves (PSG) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 0:1.
7' Bradley Barcola (PSG) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Geronimo Rulli comes off the line to clear the ball away.
5' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) sends a superb lead pass into the penalty area and finds Bradley Barcola, who fails to shoot.

4' A neat pass is well received by Ousmane Dembele (PSG), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
3' Bradley Barcola (PSG) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Francois Letexier who sees an offensive foul.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! PSG will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Francois Letexier.
